management.loopback: Management API may bind loopback; local CLI/desktop SSH forwarding requires Bearer service key and TLS server verification.
management.webController: A trusted web management backend connects only over private HTTPS with mTLS and a separate Bearer platform-admin token per Core binding.
management.desktopAccess: A remote operator may use a restricted OpenSSH/bastion port-forward to loopback Management API; the client verifies server TLS and uses Bearer authorization.
management.userAuthorization: Core v1 has no human user or role database; an external management backend may authenticate users before calling Core. Core authenticates and audits only the authenticated client binding principal.
management.rawKey: Service key plaintext is returned once during create/rotate; only a verifier/hash is persisted.
management.trustRoots: Management client trust roots and plugin workload trust roots MUST be distinct.
management.health: Unauthenticated health endpoint exposes process health only and no configuration or runtime inventory.

plugins.local: Core supervises a plugin process on an assigned loopback endpoint.
plugins.remote: A stable Service endpoint uses TLS/mTLS; each externally issued workload-replica identity maps to one logical plugin instance.
plugins.clientIdentities: Remote Core control RPCs and plugin data-plane Call/Stream use distinct workload client identities and scopes; the plugin rejects RPCs outside the identity scope.
plugins.replicas: Ready replicas share protocol, release, Manifest and settings digests; every new gRPC connection repeats TLS validation and handshake.
plugins.recovery: Core reconnects without replaying a unary Call with unknown outcome; an interrupted Stream closes and is not migrated to another replica.
plugins.degradedMode: An unavailable plugin degrades only its bound routes; unrelated routes remain available.
plugins.dataPath: Connected data-plane plugins handle user traffic directly; Core Management API never proxies user request bodies.
plugins.grantBroker: Only a narrow plugin-to-Core scoped-secret redemption callback is permitted; it does not proxy client traffic.
plugins.rotation: External CA rotation uses credential replacement and rolling restart; rejected/revoked certificates fail closed.

secrets.adminAudit: Never stores native request/response bodies or sensitive headers.

storage.database: SQLite on local filesystem; network filesystem database mounts are unsupported.
storage.artifactStore: Plugin-owned runtime files remain outside Core; plugin settings and revisions are stored in SQLite.
storage.runtime: Active configuration is hydrated into an immutable in-memory snapshot; user request paths do not read SQLite or config files.
